publications.title: OS-native Agents: Managing User Tasks in the Dynamic Mobile World

summary.zh: 将状态感知、跨应用能力调用与授权机制纳入智能体架构，并构建 DynamicWorld，评测环境与用户需求变化下的持续任务管理。
summary.en: The framework brings state awareness, cross-application capabilities, and authorization into the agent architecture. DynamicWorld evaluates ongoing task management as environments and user needs change.

image_alt.zh: OS-native Agent 框架：持久化任务会话、原生状态监听、跨应用能力与授权机制。
image_alt.en: OS-native Agent framework with persistent task sessions, native state monitors, cross-application capabilities, and authorization.

contribution.zh: 研究智能体持续管理手机任务所需的操作系统原生支持。
contribution.en: Exploring the native OS support agents need to manage ongoing mobile tasks.

thumbnail_alt.zh: 概念示意：智能体在状态变化后持续协调跨应用任务。
thumbnail_alt.en: Conceptual overview: an ongoing task session observes changes and acts across applications.

publications.title: TierMem: Balancing Compressed Memory and Raw Evidence for Long-Horizon Agent Memory

summary.zh: 优先使用压缩记忆，在证据不足时回溯原始记录，并将有依据的信息更新回记忆。
summary.en: Agents use compact memory by default, retrieve raw records when evidence is insufficient, and update memory with evidence-backed information.

image_alt.en: TierMem architecture linking summary memory to raw evidence with a router and consolidation loop.
image_alt.zh: TierMem 架构：通过路由器与证据回写连接摘要记忆和原始日志。

contribution.zh: 让长期记忆兼顾使用效率与细节保留。
contribution.en: Balancing efficient long-term memory with access to important details.

thumbnail_alt.zh: 概念示意：压缩记忆按需回溯原始证据，并依据证据更新记忆。
thumbnail_alt.en: Conceptual overview: compact memory connects to raw evidence through retrieval and evidence-backed updates.

publications.title: MTalk-Bench: Evaluating Speech-to-Speech Models in Multi-Turn Dialogues via Arena-style and Rubrics Protocols

summary.zh: 结合成对比较与细粒度评分，分析模型表现及不同评测方法的可靠性。
summary.en: Pairwise comparisons and detailed rubrics help analyze model performance and the reliability of different evaluation methods.

image_alt.en: MTalk-Bench overview connecting speech-aware data construction with Arena-style and rubric-based evaluation.
image_alt.zh: MTalk-Bench 总览：从多维语音对话构造到 Arena 成对比较与 Rubrics 细粒度评测。

contribution.zh: 评估语音模型在多轮对话中理解内容、语音线索与环境声音的能力。
contribution.en: Evaluating content, vocal cues, and ambient sound in multi-turn spoken interaction.

thumbnail_alt.zh: 概念示意：多轮语音对话通过成对比较与细粒度评分进行评测。
thumbnail_alt.en: Conceptual overview: multi-turn speech is evaluated through pairwise comparisons and rubrics.
